subject: english
stem: Please listen to this short update. Which detail is stated in the message?
options: heavy rain is expected before one forty near the art room
heavy rain is expected after ten o'clock near the health center
light rain is expected after ten o'clock near the art room
heavy rain is expected after ten o'clock near the art room

optionRationales.reason: heavy rain is expected before one forty near the art room：此項把「after ten o'clock」改成「before one forty」。音稿明確陳述「heavy rain is expected after ten o'clock near the art room」。因此，鎖定證據支持「heavy rain is expected after ten o'clock near the art room」。

heavy rain is expected after ten o'clock near the health center：此項把「art room」改成「health center」。音稿明確陳述「heavy rain is expected after ten o'clock near the art room」。因此，鎖定證據支持「heavy rain is expected after ten o'clock near the art room」。

light rain is expected after ten o'clock near the art room：此項把「heavy」改成「light」。音稿明確陳述「heavy rain is expected after ten o'clock near the art room」。因此，鎖定證據支持「heavy rain is expected after ten o'clock near the art room」。
heavy rain is expected after ten o'clock near the art room：完整逐字稿明確支持此項。音稿明確陳述「heavy rain is expected after ten o'clock near the art room」。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：逐句比對鎖定逐字稿，答案為「heavy rain is expected after ten o'clock near the art room」。
獨立覆核 B：重新依時間順序核對說話者、細節與行動，只有「heavy rain is expected after ten o'clock near the art room」成立。
